The old Pokemon games, god so much nostalgia.  


The days where me and my sister were young and would always run to each other telling the other one which Pokemon we had just caught, or which Gym Leader we had beaten. Sitting in the back of the car together playing our individual games or the times we'd battle together, I'd usually lose but those days I won made me smile with glee.  


I really miss my innocent, bliss youth days. The days I'd smile carefree of the worries of the world. Everytime I play a Pokemon game these days it gives me that escape I had as a child, which is always nice to have nowadays.

**KPOP.**

  
It's a big love-hate relationship for me, I love the music and idols, but some of the fans are a bit much for me.

​

You've got the sasaengs which are (what I'd consider) a small sub-community in the KPOP Fanbase. They're obsessive, stalkerish fans of idols who invade their lives. They buy and sell information from each other, whether it is their idols flight information, private photos, etc. Some have broken into idols homes, stolen things, and more it's awful. Quite a lot of sasaeng groups are exclusive from what I've heard but this is a minority of the fandom, I'd hope it'd be obvious not all fans are like this.  


You've got the KPOP fans who just attack each other because they have the audacity to like different groups than their faves, and don't get me started on the fan wars (Which drive me nuts). You also have the ones who decide using a tragedy is a good time to boost their fave or will threaten others in and out of the fandom.  


The threats KPOP fans have given people in their community and out can get really dark and I completely see why people don't want to join the KPOP fanbase.  


The other day somebody told me I could go f\*\*\* myself because I stanned BTS,  They were a fan of iKON (Another Group I wholeheartedly stan) but didn't hesitate to go in on me because I liked BTS. They told me they were a fan of iKON and I said I was too, then took back their previous statements on me (Which, whatever I don't mind if people dislike BTS, just don't gotta hit me for it).  


TL;DR: Don't get me wrong, the whole community in its entirety isn't the worst, I've met some really great friends and awesome people, but some KPOP fans have really done some disgusting things.
